title: Energy bound on vertex values
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of degree $D>0$, and let $F$ assign a rational number to each vertex. Suppose $F$ is nonnegative everywhere, $F(t)=0$ at a vertex $t$, and $F(u)-\operatorname{avg}_{v\sim u}F(v)\le 1$ whenever $u\ne t$, where the average is over the $D$ neighbor slots of $u$. Suppose also that every vertex $u$ with $F(u)>0$ can reach $t$ by a finite sequence of steps along those neighbor slots. Then, for every vertex $u$, $F(u)\le 2D\,|V|^3$.

$F$ is a rational-valued function on the vertices

Every vertex $u$ with $F(u)>0$ reaches $t$ by a finite sequence of neighbor-slot steps
